judge.rationale: The answer accurately reflects the policy wording and does not invent any coverage, which is consistent with the gold notes.

cases.answer: Digit Private Car Liability Only Policy does not cover own damage to your car. This policy is specifically for liability towards third parties. Own damage coverage is typically found in comprehensive or motor third-party insurance policies.
